notes.subject: feat(sandbox): add piped sandboxed process launches for non-terminal hosts
notes.summary: Adds piped sandboxed process launches (launchSandboxedProcess, prepareWorkspaceSandboxLaunch, createSandboxedWorkspaceProcessLauncher) so hosts without a terminal can run commands through the macOS sandbox, with VS Code terminal behavior unchanged.
